instruction: In the Excel spreadsheet, identify the highest-rated film released from 2010 through 2020 and apply a background color to its entire row.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(1)

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding highest-rated movie from 2010-2020 and highlighting the entire row. Verified with Python: Inception (2010) with rating 8.8 is the highest-rated movie in this period, located at row 147 in the original data. Evaluator checks if row 147 has background fill color applied across all cells (at least 80% of cells in the row must be highlighted).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly verifies entire row highlighting: The getter iterates through all columns in row 147 (up to max_col) and checks if each cell has fill color applied.

Appropriate tolerance threshold: Uses 80% threshold to determine if row is highlighted, which handles edge cases where some cells might be empty or unformatted while still verifying the entire row is highlighted.
Correct expected value: Row 147 is verified to contain Inception (2010) with rating 8.8, which is the highest-rated movie from 2010-2020 according to the metadata explanation.
Complete coverage: The evaluator checks the exact requirement - that the entire row of the highest-rated movie is highlighted with background color.
Proper state handling: Postconfig includes Ctrl+S to save the file, ensuring the highlighting state is persisted before verification.
